question: Which scheme was launched to promote entrepreneurship among SC and ST communities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Stand-Up India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Stand-Up India** scheme was launched on **5 April 2016** by the Government of India.
 
• The scheme aims to **promote entrepreneurship among Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), and women entrepreneurs**.
 
• Under the scheme, loans ranging from **₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore** are provided to eligible entrepreneurs for setting up greenfield enterprises.
 
• It covers sectors like manufacturing, services, and trading, enabling inclusive growth and economic empowerment.
 
• The scheme is implemented through **Scheduled Commercial Banks** across India, ensuring accessibility to credit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Greenfield Enterprise**

 
 
• A greenfield enterprise refers to a business that is established from scratch and is completely new, without any existing infrastructure.
 
• Under Stand-Up India, the focus is on creating such enterprises by SC, ST, and women entrepreneurs.
 
 
 
• **Eligibility Criteria for Stand-Up India**
 
 
• The applicant must be an SC/ST or a woman entrepreneur.
 
• The age of the applicant should be between 18-65 years.
 
• The enterprise must be a greenfield project in manufacturing, services, or trading sectors.
 
 
 
• **Loan Structure**
 
 
• Loans are provided for amounts between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore.
 
• Margin money requirement is limited to 25% of the project cost.
 
• Repayment tenure is up to 7 years, with a maximum moratorium period of 18 months.
 
 
 
• **Digital Platform for Stand-Up India**
 
 
• A dedicated online portal (www.standupmitra.in) has been created to facilitate the scheme.
 
• The portal provides handholding support, including guidance for project preparation and connecting applicants with banks.
